paragraphs.en: Dorothy turned to Tiktok and said, "First, we need to find a way out of these rocks. The Wheelers are below us and threaten to harm us."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西转过身对蒂托克说：“首先，我们需要找到一条出路，避开这些岩石。威勒一家就在下面，对我们虎视眈眈，随时可能给我们制造麻烦。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok replied slowly, "There is no reason to fear the Wheelers." Dorothy asked, "Why not?"
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克 Tok 犹豫了一下，缓缓说道：“不必害怕威勒一家。”多萝西好奇地问：“为什么呢？”

paragraphs.en: "Because they are... ag-gr-gr-r-r-," Tiktok began, then stopped abruptly, his arm raised and fingers spread like a fan.
paragraphs.zh: “因为它们是……啊——啊——”Tiktok 开始说道，然后突然中断了，手臂抬起，手指张开，像一把展开的扇子。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy gasped. The hen calmly said, "He's run down; you didn't wind him tight enough."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西惊叫道。母鸡冷静地说：“它累坏了；你没把它上紧上够。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy searched for the key but found it missing. She exclaimed, "The key is gone!"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西四处寻找钥匙，却不见踪影。她脱口而出：“钥匙不见了！”

paragraphs.en: Billina suggested, "It probably fell into a crack when he bowed to you." They eventually located the key and wound Tiktok up.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜建议说：“他给你鞠躬的时候可能掉进了裂缝里。”最终她们找到了钥匙，并给提柯特上满了发条。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok said, "I ran down because I wasn't wound tightly enough at first."
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克 Tok 离开时说：“我跑下去是因为最初没有紧缠足够的线。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy rewound the action clockwork. Billina advised carrying the key in her pocket to avoid losing it again.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西重新调整了发条闹钟。比琳娜建议她把钥匙放在口袋里，以免再次遗失。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy then asked, "Now tell me about the Wheelers." Tiktok assured her they were harmless and that she should not be afraid of them.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西问道：“现在告诉我一下威勒一家的情况吧。”蒂克托克向她保证，威勒一家并无恶意，她不必害怕他们。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy opened her tin dinner-pail to find a feast inside. The pail contained lemonade, turkey slices, cold tongue, lobster salad, bread and butter, a custard pie, an orange, nine large strawberries, and nuts and raisins. Curiously, the nuts were already cracked open.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西打开她的锡饭盒，里面竟然是一顿丰盛的晚餐。饭盒里装着柠檬汽水、火鸡片、冷熏肠、龙虾沙拉、面包黄油、蛋奶派、一个橙子、九颗大草莓以及坚果和葡萄干。更奇怪的是，那些坚果已经被剥开了壳。

paragraphs.en: She spread the food on a rock and began eating, first offering some to Tiktok, who declined as he was just a machine. Dorothy then offered Billina a share but the hen refused, saying she preferred her bugs and ants.
paragraphs.zh: 她把食物铺在一块石头上开始吃起来，首先递给蒂托克一些，但后者婉拒了，因为他只是个机器。接着，多萝西给比琳娜也分了一份，不过这只母鸡谢绝了，她说自己更喜欢虫子和蚂蚁。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy asked Tiktok if the lunch-box trees and dinner-pail trees belonged to the Wheelers. Tiktok replied that they actually belonged to King Evoldo's royal family, though there was no king now since he had jumped into the sea and his family had been transformed by the Nome King. Dorothy turned the pail over and found the royal "E" mark stamped on its bottom.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西问托托克，午餐树和晚餐桶树是否属于威勒一家。托托认为这些树木其实归厄沃尔多国王的王室所有，尽管现在没有国王了，因为他跳进了海里，他的家族被 Nome 王国的巫师改变了身份。多萝西翻转了水桶，发现底部刻着一个皇家的“E”标志。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy wondered if the Wheelers were the only inhabitants of the Land of Ev. Tiktok explained that they lived in a small area behind the woods, but had always been mischievous and impertinent.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西怀疑韦尔一家是否是埃夫国唯一的居民。蒂克托克解释说，他们住在森林后面的一个小区域里，但一直行为调皮，态度放肆。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok explained his origins to Dorothy. He was created by Smith & Tinker in Evna, a town where the royal palace stands. Tiktok was unique among their creations and the only fully functional mechanical man they ever completed.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克托克向多萝西讲述了他自己的身世。他是由斯密斯与廷克公司在埃瓦纳镇创造出来的，而埃瓦纳镇正矗立着王宫。在他们的作品中，蒂克托克独树一帜，是他们唯一完成的完全功能齐全的机械人。

paragraphs.en: "Smith & Tinker were truly remarkable inventors," said Dorothy, munching on her custard pie.
paragraphs.zh: “史密斯和廷克真是了不起的发明家，”多萝西边吃着布丁派边说道。

paragraphs.en: "They were indeed," agreed Tiktok. "Mr. Smith drowned while painting a river, and Mr. Tinker moved to the moon after picking stars for the king's crown."
paragraphs.zh: “确实如此，”提克托克附和道，“史密斯先生在给河流绘画时溺水身亡，而金匠廷克则在为王冠挑选星星后移居月球。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy felt sorry for the loss of these men. "They must have been great losses to this country and to you," she said.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西为失去这些男人感到惋惜。“对他们所在的国家和您来说，这一定是巨大的损失吧，”她说。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok nodded. "I am complex and no one can repair me if I break down. You can imagine how intricate my machinery is."
paragraphs.zh: 蒂克 Tok 点了点头，“我构造复杂，一旦出问题就没人能修理。你可以想象我的机械结构有多精密。”

paragraphs.en: "Of course, it's hard to picture," Dorothy replied.
paragraphs.zh: “当然，这很难想象，”多萝西回答道。

paragraphs.en: Tiktok then turned halfway around, focusing on finding a way out of the rock. "The best thinker I ever knew was a scarecrow," he said, recalling his encounter with one in Oz.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，蒂克托克转身了一半，专心寻找脱身之策。“我认识的最聪明的人是一个稻草人，”他回忆起在奥兹国遇到的那个稻草人的经历时说道。

paragraphs.en: Billina scoffed, but Dorothy agreed. "He thought just as well before getting brains," she added, remembering how the scarecrow had solved problems without them.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜轻蔑地哼了一声，但多萝西表示赞同。“他没脑子的时候想法也一样好。”她补充道，想起了稻草人没有智慧时也能解决难题的情景。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy opened the dinner pail and began to eat. Billina, looking cross due to a lack of bugs, asked skeptically, "Do you expect me to believe all that rubbish about the Land of Oz?"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西打开饭桶开始吃了起来。由于找不到虫子，比林纳一脸怀疑地交叉着眉头问道：“你指望我信那些关于奥兹国的胡说八道吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Rubbish?" Dorothy replied, munching on some nuts and raisins. "Why, your stories about animals talking and a living tin woodman and a thinking scarecrow are impossible."
paragraphs.zh: “胡说八道？”多萝西边嚼着坚果和葡萄干边回答，“你的那些关于动物会说话、活生生的铜木人以及能思考的稻草人都不可能的事，我可不信。”

paragraphs.en: "They are real," Dorothy insisted. "I've seen them myself."
paragraphs.zh: “他们确实存在，”多萝西坚持道，“我亲眼见过。”

paragraphs.en: Billina shook her head in disbelief.
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜难以置信地摇了摇头。
